llm.reply:
The retrieved records tie the two genes to hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes and to Fanconi anemia subtypes. The first gene is NCBIGene:672, BRCA1 DNA repair associated [1]. The second gene is NCBIGene:675, BRCA2 DNA repair associated [6].

## Hereditary cancer susceptibility

One associated condition is Familial cancer of breast [2]. Another is Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [3]. The set also includes Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 2 [9]. Familial prostate cancer is listed as well [11]. Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4 appears among the conditions [4]. Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 2 is also included [12]. Glioma susceptibility 3 completes this group [10].

## Fanconi anemia and tumours

The records include Fanconi anemia complementation group S [5]. They also include Fanconi anemia complementation group D1 [8]. Medulloblastoma is among the associated diseases [7]. Wilms tumor 1 is also listed [13].

## Biological basis

The BRCA1 gene summary describes a protein that helps preserve genome integrity and suppresses tumours [24: "plays a role in maintaining genomic stability, and it also acts as a tumor suppressor"]. It also accounts for a large share of inherited breast and ovarian cancer [24: "responsible for approximately 40% of inherited breast cancers and more than 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers"]. A linked process is GO:0000724, double-strand break repair via homologous recombination [21].

llm.reply:
The retrieved associations for BRCA1 and BRCA2 span hereditary breast, ovarian, pancreatic and prostate cancer susceptibility, Fanconi anemia complementation groups, and several tumor types. The first gene record is NCBIGene:672, BRCA1 DNA repair associated [1]. The second is NCBIGene:675, BRCA2 DNA repair associated [6].

## Associated conditions

One associated disease is Familial cancer of breast [2]. Another is Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [3]. Another is Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 2 [9]. Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4 is also listed [4]. So is Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 2 [12]. Familial prostate cancer is associated as well [11]. Fanconi anemia complementation group S is listed [5]. So is Fanconi anemia complementation group D1 [8]. Tumor-related entries include Medulloblastoma [7]. Glioma susceptibility 3 is another [10]. Wilms tumor 1 is also listed [13].

## Gene function

The gene symbol is BRCA1 [14]. The gene name is BRCA1 [18]. The OMIM entry is BRCA1 DNA REPAIR-ASSOCIATED PROTEIN; BRCA1 [17]. BRCA1 acts in genome maintenance and tumor suppression [24: "plays a role in maintaining genomic stability, and it also acts as a tumor suppressor"]. Its mutations explain a large share of hereditary disease [24: "approximately 40% of inherited breast cancers and more than 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers"]. An annotated process is GO:0000724, double-strand break repair via homologous recombination [21]. Another is GO:0006281, DNA repair [27].

## Literature and variants

One paper is BRCA1-BARD1 promotes RAD51-mediated homologous DNA pairing. [15]. Another is BRCA1: An Endocrine and Metabolic Regulator. [22]. Another is Preneoplastic stromal cells promote BRCA1-mediated breast tumorigenesis. [28]. A linked publication is 28976962 [20]. Another is 35432218 [26]. One ClinVar variant is NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.5243_5277+2788del [16]. Another is NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.5277+2916_5277+2946delinsGG [23]. Another is NG_005905.2:g.(147057_150288)_(160933_166866)del [29].

## Clinical trials

One trial is Germline BRCA1 and BRCA2 Mutations in Jewish Women Affected by Breast Cancer [19]. Another is BRCA1 Haploinsufficiency and Gene Expression [25]. A third is Study to Evaluate Treatment Customized According to RAP80 and BRCA1 in Patients With Advanced Lung Carcinoma [30].
